jobs.title: Strategic Finance
jobs.description:
fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.



About the role

We’re looking for a strategic finance partner to join our growing finance team. You will help across all functions - consolidations, KPI reporting and tracking, systems implementation, and ad hoc strategic projects. This is not a typical B2B SaaS business, and fal is not a typical environment: we’re a deliberately flat organization with very few titles or layers, moving extremely fast with data and processes still being built. The ideal person is interdisciplinary, resourceful, low-ego, and energized by ambiguity and a high-urgency pace.

What you’ll do

 - Planning: Support company-wide financial planning, forecasting, and budgeting processes

 - Models: Help maintain and extend our bottoms-up revenue model across GTM motions and products, track and report actuals vs variances, and surface insights

 - Systems: Assist with FP&A software implementation and additional finance systems (ERP, procurement)

 - Reporting: Partner with accounting and data on monthly revenue reporting, ensuring product- and customer-level breakdowns are accurate and usable

 - Visibility: Build dashboards giving leadership real-time visibility into key performance metrics vs plan and forecast

 - Make the data usable: Go into the data (e.g. BigQuery), spot what’s wrong, and drive it to a fix with the right people; we’re a lean team without a dedicated analyst, so this is core to the job

 - Automate: Use AI tools to automate recurring financial workflows

Qualifications/Nice to haves:

 - 4-6 years of experience across investment banking, private equity or strategic finance at a fast-growing startup

 - Able to read and troubleshoot data and validate metrics independently. You don’t need to hand-write SQL, but you must read a table, find what’s wrong, and problem-solve it

 - Working knowledge of accounting concepts (billings, deferred revenue, AR, rev rec) and able to translate them for non-finance stakeholders

 - Strong financial-modeling skill; can distill complex data into clear, actionable insights

 - Strong cross-functional communication and influencing skills

 - Resourceful, low-ego, high-urgency, and genuinely excited to operate in a fast-changing AI startup with evolving processes

 - Experience in AI, cloud, or large-scale computing infrastructure

 - Experience implementing a modern FP&A tool

 - Track record of building/using AI tools to automate financial workflows

 


WHAT WE OFFER AT FAL

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - A lot of learning and growth opportunities

 - We offer visa sponsorship and will help you relocate to San Francisco.

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance (US)

 - Regular team events and offsites


COMPENSATION

 - $ 180,000 - $220,000 + equity + comprehensive benefits package



U.S. EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY INFORMATION:

fal provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other classification protected by applicable law.

ABOUT THIS ROLE:

fal is looking for an Event Marketing Manager to help bring our community, developer, and broader marketing programs to life.

This is a hands-on role for someone who loves producing great experiences and can move comfortably between in-person and virtual formats. You'll be working on developer and community events, meetups, webinars, third-party events, partner programs, ABM activations, and other marketing moments as our event portfolio grows.

We’re looking for someone who is equally comfortable building a run of show, configuring a webinar platform, coordinating speakers, working with vendors, and being onsite making sure every detail comes together.

This role is based in San Francisco.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own end-to-end execution for community and developer programs, including meetups, workshops, hackathons, dinners, and other gatherings

 - Produce webinars/livestreams and virtual events from setup through live execution, including platform configuration, registration, speaker prep, rehearsals, technical production, and post-event follow-up

 - Partner closely with Community Marketing to translate programming ideas into well-run, memorable experiences for developers and creators

 - Support select third-party conferences, partner activations, customer programs, ABM events, and other initiatives as needed

 - Build event timelines, project plans, run-of-shows, staffing plans, and Know Before You Go documentation

 - Coordinate venues, vendors, production partners, catering, swag, shipping, registration, and onsite logistics

 - Manage speakers and internal stakeholders, keeping teams aligned on deadlines, roles, and event objectives

 - Help manage event budgets and contracts and keep programs on scope and on schedule

 - Partner with Marketing, Community, Sales, Partnerships, Brand, and other cross-functional teams

 - Track attendance, engagement, feedback, and other program results, and use learnings to continuously improve future events

 - Help build repeatable processes and playbooks as fal’s event portfolio scales




QUALIFICATIONS/NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 5+ years of experience in event marketing, event production, developer marketing, community marketing, field marketing, or a related role

 - Experience owning events end-to-end, from initial planning through onsite or live execution

 - Hands-on experience producing webinars or virtual events and confidence managing the technical details behind them

 - Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple programs, stakeholders, and deadlines at once

 - Excellent attention to detail and a high bar for the attendee experience

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

 - A collaborative, low-ego working style and comfort partnering across technical and non-technical teams

 - The ability to operate independently, solve problems quickly, and stay calm when plans change

 - Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where not every process or playbook already exists

 - Ability to travel as needed for events

 - Experience working with developer, creator, startup, or technical communities

 - Experience at an AI, developer tools, infrastructure, or high-growth technology company

 - Experience with event registration, webinar, CRM, or marketing automation platforms

 - Familiarity with hackathons, developer workshops, or hands-on technical programming
   


WHAT WE OFFER AT FAL

 - A lot of learning and growth opportunities

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.




ABOUT THIS ROLE:

fal is looking for a Field Marketing Manager to build and execute high-impact programs that deepen engagement with our most important enterprise accounts and turn field marketing into a meaningful driver of pipeline and revenue.

You’ll partner closely with Sales to understand territory priorities, strategic accounts, and active opportunities, then translate those priorities into thoughtful field and ABM programs. Your portfolio may include executive dinners and roundtables, customer gatherings, account-specific experiences, partner activations, third-party conferences, and repeatable sales-led programs.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands that great field marketing is more than running events: it’s creating the right programs for the right accounts at the right moment in the sales cycle and making sure there is a clear path from engagement to business impact.

Location is flexible within the US, with travel required based on the event calendar.

What you’ll do

 - Partner closely with Enterprise Sales to build field marketing plans aligned to priority accounts, territories, pipeline, and revenue goals

 - Own ABM events and experiences for priority accounts, in partnership with Sales and Growth Marketing.

 - Own a portfolio of field programs including executive roundtables, dinners, customer gatherings, workshops, partner activations, and other high-touch experiences

 - Evaluate third-party conferences and sponsorship opportunities based on audience quality, account coverage, business objectives, and expected impact

 - Build activation strategies around priority industry events, including executive programming, customer moments, meetings, dinners, and surrounding experiences

 - Partner with Sales on account targeting, invitation strategy, meeting generation, attendee engagement, and post-event follow-up

 - Collaborate with Partnerships on co-marketing programs and joint events that extend fal’s reach into priority accounts and audiences

 - Build repeatable, lightweight programs that allow Sales to activate key markets and accounts without requiring a bespoke event every time

 - Manage event and program execution end-to-end, including budgets, agencies, vendors, timelines, logistics, and onsite delivery

 - Partner across Product Marketing, Creative, Community, Partnerships, Marketing Ops, and other teams to deliver cohesive programs

 - Measure program performance across target-account engagement, meetings, pipeline influence, deal progression, and revenue impact

 - Capture learnings and build scalable playbooks, processes, and reporting as fal’s field marketing motion grows




QUALIFICATIONS/NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 5+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, ABM, demand generation, or integrated marketing, ideally in enterprise technology

 - Experience building field marketing programs in close partnership with enterprise Sales teams

 - Strong understanding of ABM and how marketing programs can support different stages of the enterprise buying journey

 - A track record of executing events and experiences tied to account engagement, pipeline, or revenue objectives

 - Strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize programs based on business impact rather than activity

 - Experience managing budgets, vendors, agencies, and multiple programs simultaneously

 - Strong project management skills and exceptional attention to detail

 - Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

 - Comfort operating independently and building new programs and processes from scratch

 - A hands-on approach - you’re equally comfortable developing the strategy and being onsite making sure it gets executed well

 - Ability to travel regularly based on the field calendar

 - Experience marketing AI, developer tools, infrastructure, or another technical enterprise product

 - Experience marketing to large strategic or named accounts

 - Experience building executive programs or high-touch ABM experiences

 - Experience working with technology or cloud partners on joint field programs

 - Familiarity with Salesforce and marketing attribution/reporting

jobs.title: Technical Content Marketing Manager, Infrastructure
jobs.description:
fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.




ABOUT THIS ROLE:

We’re looking for a Technical Content Marketing Manager, Infrastructure to tell the story of fal’s infrastructure, from Serverless for deploying and scaling custom AI models across thousands of GPUs, to Compute for training on large, interconnected GPU clusters.

You’ll work closely with Marketing, Product, and Engineering to turn complex technical work into content that developers and technical decision-makers actually want to read, and that makes fal the obvious place to run generative media workloads.

Some of the most interesting work happening at fal is deep inside the infrastructure, and most of the market never sees it.

Your job is to uncover those stories and make them impossible to miss.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Write technical blogs, landing pages, guides, tutorials, solution pages, and product launch content for Serverless and Compute

 - Work directly with engineers to uncover interesting technical stories and turn them into clear, compelling content

 - Explain topics like inference performance, GPU infrastructure, autoscaling, distributed workloads, model serving, training, latency, and throughput

 - Develop technical deep dives and architecture content that demonstrates how fal works under the hood

 - Create benchmarks and competitive content that clearly communicates where fal performs differently

 - Interview customers and turn their work into technical case studies and customer stories

 - Support SEO and AEO by building authoritative content around the infrastructure problems developers are searching for

 - Translate product launches and engineering breakthroughs into narratives that resonate beyond the engineering team

 - Build and maintain a consistent technical voice for fal across the website, blog, and other developer-facing channels

 - Work with Product Marketing to identify the stories and topics that will drive awareness, adoption, and demand




QUALIFICATIONS/NICE-TO-HAVES

 - An exceptional technical writer who can make complex systems clear without dumbing them down

 - Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, AI/ML infrastructure, developer tools, or adjacent technical products

 - Comfortable talking with engineers about GPUs, inference, distributed systems, APIs, model serving, and performance

 - Able to independently research technical subjects, ask the right questions, and turn engineering knowledge into polished content

 - Strong instincts for both technical accuracy and storytelling

 - Experience writing for developers and technical decision-makers

 - Understanding of SEO/AEO and content distribution, not just writing in isolation

 - Comfortable moving quickly and publishing frequently in a fast-changing technical environment
   


WHAT WE OFFER AT FAL

 - Interesting and challenging work

 - A lot of learning and growth opportunities

 - We offer visa sponsorship and will help you relocate to San Francisco.
